verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for accounting and ledger software, so the axis applies. Every piece of evidence describes Digits as a vendor-hosted SaaS: hosted API endpoints, a hosted MCP server at api.digits.com/mcp, a vendor-run resettable demo instance, and per-business subscription pricing. Nothing documents a self-hostable or on-premises distribution of the core product, and the developer demo instance is a hosted sandbox, not self-hosting.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
